about: Round-10 founder-context regressions for test_founder_context_r10.py. Origins: qa-r9-disclosed = the IV9 repro strings from the round-9 QA report (regressions, not unseen validation); owner-r10-fresh = the round-10 repair owner's own cases, written before the r10 change and run once before tuning (first results are in the round-10 report); owner-r10-fresh-cost = fresh clean controls the check still withholds (documented cost, pinned). e: w = withhold, k = keep; r: key of reasons; t: the eligible twin (the same claim with the qualifier replaced by a plain sentence), which must print; st: false = item without founder_stated; sp: speaker; x: excerpt; sec: section.

claims.P: We will open the dock analytics beta to every warehouse in November.

reasons.context: not backed by the rest of the founder's words
reasons.dependency: has a precondition, an open decision or a request for time
reasons.forward: reads as forward-looking without a founder statement
reasons.attribution-label: ambiguous quoted or continued speaker attribution
reasons.attribution-sentence: attributes words to someone or something else
reasons.not-founder-turn: is not from a turn of the speaker named
reasons.claim-itself: the sentence that is the claim
